item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
Update metadata fix

Quick fix release. v1.1.0's auto-updater metadata didn't match the appcast feed, which made some users see "update available" prompts even after installing v1.1.0. v1.1.1 corrects this — once you're on v1.1.1, the prompt stops.

No feature changes from v1.1.0. Pure metadata cleanup.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
Multi-Provider AI Support

Sato now talks to more than just Claude. Pick from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Ollama, and switch between models without leaving the menu bar.

What's new

  • Three AI providers: Anthropic (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5), OpenAI (GPT-5.4, Mini, Nano), and Ollama (local or cloud)
  • Context Profiles can override your default provider and model
  • Markdown now renders properly in responses
  • Fixed permissions screen getting stuck after granting Screen Recording
  • Stable bundle identifier going forward

Heads up: Bundle identifier changed under the hood, so macOS will ask for permissions one more time on first launch. After this release, future updates are seamless.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Signed & Notarized

Sato is now signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple. No more "unidentified developer" warning on first launch.

  • Apple Developer ID signed
  • Notarized by Apple
  • Smooth first-launch experience on macOS Sequoia and later

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
Sato 1.0.0 — Initial Release

The first public release of Sato.

Features

  • Five pixel art companions: Max, Sky, Lexi, Rover, and Paris
  • Screenshot-based AI assistance via Ctrl+Option
  • Chat sidebar for follow-up conversations
  • Context profiles for customizing AI behavior
  • Stealth mode
  • Automatic updates via Sparkle
